gaps.title: Canonical visual compare renderer
gaps.detail: Side-by-side raster/design previews, wipe slider and heatmap require canonical preview/render URLs. The UI intentionally does not synthesize previews from storage keys.

gaps.title: Before/after property values
gaps.detail: NODE-38 semantic diff currently identifies changed node/property categories but does not expose exact before and after values such as 68→58.

gaps.title: Approval audit projection
gaps.detail: ArtifactVersion APPROVED status is visible, but reviewer identity, validation reference and approval timestamp do not yet have a dedicated permission-aware safe read projection.

gaps.title: Exact BrandRuleSet provenance
gaps.detail: The persistence model contains a brand rule-set version reference, but the canonical ArtifactVersion public contract used by NODE-59 does not expose it.

gaps.title: Large history pagination and virtualization
gaps.detail: Current product projection returns the artifact history set in one response and the inspector list is scroll-bounded, not cursor-paginated/virtualized for very large histories.

gaps.title: Browser and PostgreSQL E2E
gaps.detail: Need real database/browser proof for exact open, compare, stale-head restore conflict, fork, approved-version immutability and provenance permissions.

gaps.title: Hosted GitHub Actions executed green
gaps.detail: NODE-59 cannot be COMPLETE until hosted CI runs actual steps successfully; account/runner pre-run failures are not code execution evidence.
